text:
#!name=迅雷
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0489 / 迅雷 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0443 / 迅雷去广告 / 可莉🅥[https://github.com/luestr/ProxyResource/blob/main/README.md]

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, adsp.xunlei.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, static-xl9-ssl.xunlei.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, biz.live.xunlei.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, ct.niu.xunlei.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, mou.niu.xunlei.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, scene.vip.xunlei.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, tw13b093.sandai.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, xlmc.sandai.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, cpm.cm.sandai.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, master.wap.dphub.sandai.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, idx.m.hub.sandai.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, liveupdate.mac.sandai.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, hub5pn.wap.sandai.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, etl.xlmc.sandai.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, test.api.xlmc.sandai.net,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, pre.api.tw06.xlmc.sandai.net,REJECT

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/images\.client\.vip\.xunlei\.com\/.+?\/advert\//i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-shoulei-ssl\.xunlei\.com\/flowhub\/v\d\/slots:batchGet/i then reject(200)

[Body Rewrite]
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/conf-m-ssl\.xunlei\.com\/external\/ 'delpaths([["values","me_config","entrance_list_vertical_enable"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/conf-m-ssl\.xunlei\.com\/external\/ 'delpaths([["values","me_config","common_service_list"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/conf-m-ssl\.xunlei\.com\/external\/ 'delpaths([["values","me_config","banner_service_list"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api-shoulei-ssl\.xunlei\.com\/flowhub\/v1\/slots:batchGet$ '.slots |= map(select(.id == "xl_ios_mytab_vipicon" or (.native.assets.title.text.value? and (.native.assets.title.text.value | . == "清理助手" or . == "云盘容量" or . == "远程设备"))))'

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% images.client.vip.xunlei.com, api-shoulei-ssl.xunlei.com, conf-m-ssl.xunlei.com
